findings.summary: WP-006 repair round 1 closed all five required fixes with independent recomputation, leaving the primary FALSIFIED verdict untouched. RF1: FN double-reset control recomputed from raw calibration rows across ALL sites including manifest-less openlibrary — corpus 67/74 (FN rate 9.46%), openlibrary 5/12, static core 48/48, stateful 14/14. Notable adjudication: the team showed the PRIOR audit's own headline '62 pass/74' was internally inconsistent (its per-site table sums to 67/74, which raw rows confirm); correction recorded against the predecessor's text. RF2: report+ledger errata purely additive (zero deleted lines), all five quoted original sentences verified genuine in pre-fix git blobs. RF3: verifier v2 rerun independently — C2 full coverage 888/910 (868 manifest + 20 raw-reconstructed refs) at 0 mismatches; promised G5 check implemented and clean (875 rows, 84 disclosed role-button-only). RF4/RF5: G9 statistic corrected to actual denominator; pre-fix hashes byte-match git blobs; prereg/data/v1-verifier/results byte-identical. Primary FALSIFIED re-established independently (F1 OK 8 sites both classes; F2 FAIL producers 2<4; F4 FAIL BPs 38<60; row accounting, exclusion ledger, Fisher-Yates replay, determinism spectrum 101/102 all reproduce).

ENFORCEMENT-GATE FALSE POSITIVE (run-killing, systematic): after the auditor wrote only its two allowed outputs, the 'Enforce audit-only writes' step ran `git status --porcelain | grep -Ev '^(reports/audit/|results/audit/)'` and exited 1 because the workflow's own earlier 'Stage current control plane' step had PRE-STAGED sync files into the index (.opencode/agents/graph_runner.md, independent_auditor.md, lab_director.md, lane_director.md, physics_runner.md; directives/AUDITOR.md, directives/LANE_DIRECTOR.md). The auditor never touched them. Consequence: job conclusion=failure, run conclusion=failure, PHYSICS LANE DIRECTOR skipped — even though gate=PASS/safe_to_integrate=true had already been written. The subsequent persist step's `git add -A` then committed those staged files into the audit branch. Identical mechanism later blocked Graph run 32793580374 across ≥8 attempts. Fix direction: compare working tree against HEAD (diff of auditor-era changes only), or unstage control-plane sync before the audit session.

Minor artifact-regression caught by auditor: regenerated wp006_verification_v2.json dropped the CLI-arg-dependent key C3_rows_before_freeze_commit that v1 had recorded (v2 is otherwise a strict superset; shared values identical except C2 coverage correctly growing 868→888). Fact re-established as 0 by auditor rerun at true freeze time; advisory only, non-blocking.

~36m total wall clock (team 22m38s + audit 13m07s) to close five audit findings including fresh recomputation — cheap because repair was documentary/statistical over an existing frozen dataset. 40 stall-watch warnings logged; one provider-outage retry before the team phase started. The enforcement false positive then wasted the entire PASS outcome for this run id (Director integration happened only via later carryforward runs).
